from pathlib import Path

from .index import SkillIndex
from .schema import SkillMeta


def write_skill(name: str, body: str, root: Path) -> SkillMeta:
    """Write a skill folder: SKILL.md plus a meta file."""
    folder = root / name
    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (folder / "SKILL.md").write_text(body)
    meta = SkillMeta.from_markdown(name, body)
    (folder / "meta.json").write_text(meta.model_dump_json(indent=2))
    SkillIndex.at(root).record(meta)
    return meta


def remove_skill(name: str, root: Path) -> None:
    folder = root / name
    if folder.exists():
        for child in folder.iterdir():
            child.unlink()
        folder.rmdir()
    SkillIndex.at(root).forget(name)

async def step(self, messages: list[Message]) -> Message:
        reply = await self.model.complete(messages, tools=self.tools.schemas())
        for call in reply.tool_calls:
            tool = self.tools.get(call.name)
            result = await tool.handler(**call.arguments)
            messages.append(Message.tool(call.id, result))
        return reply

from typing import Awaitable, Callable, TypedDict


class Tool(TypedDict):
    name: str
    description: str
    handler: Callable[..., Awaitable[str]]

BATCH = 500


async def fetch_batch(source: Source) -> list[Row]:
    async with source.connect() as conn:
        rows = await conn.read(limit=BATCH)
    log.info("fetched %d rows from %s", len(rows), source.name)
    return [Row(**r) for r in rows]

from .db import table

QUARANTINE = table("quarantine")


def quarantine(row: Row, reason: str) -> None:
    QUARANTINE.insert({"row": row.model_dump(), "reason": reason, "at": now()})

from .schema import Schema


def check_row(row: Row, schema: Schema) -> list[str]:
    problems = [f"missing {f}" for f in schema.required if row.get(f) in (None, "")]
    problems += [f"{f} is not {k.__name__}" for f, k in schema.types.items() if f in row and not isinstance(row[f], k)]
    return problems
